description: Stream one explicit absolute regular file ON THE MCP-SERVER HOST into an existing upload using one PUT. No remote-client path, URL, glob or directory. Save uploadId and returned expectedSha256. After an uncertain PUT read status: uploaded -> finalize, uploading -> observe, cancelled -> explicitly create a new upload. Already uploaded bytes are never overwritten; this call can hash the same local file to recover its digest.

path.description: Explicit absolute regular file on the MCP-server host, never the remote client's filesystem.

name: claudexor_upload_import_local

expectedSha256.description: Digest of the verified local bytes. Save it for finalize; absent while uploading or cancelled.
